blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.
blocks.zh: 长视距任务的培训编码员需要具备可核查反馈的环境. 现有的管道往往遵循一个线性过程,以验证结束,确定可用性,但对提高培训价值却很少提供指导。 递归自修(RSI)往往需要模式推出或模式培训,然后进行下游评价,成本和反馈延迟在长距离任务上被放大. 我们如何利用及时,可靠的代理信号来提高训练价值并大规模地综合环境? 我们提出RepoFactory,一个自动管道,将真实的寄存器转换成可核查的环境,通过语言规格从头开始构建完整的项目. 其"环境进化循环"通过代理反馈,优化了结合有效性,结构耦合和执行范围的多功能目标. RepoFactory在17个软件领域产生10,159个环境. 关于这些环境的Qwen3.5-35B-A3B培训产生了RepoHorizen-35B-A3B,在NL2Repo-Bench上取得了22.6%的增益,在现实世界生产环境中涵盖长距离编码和代理任务的5个基准上平均获得了8.5分,而在没有环境演化的情况下则取得了17.5分和6.4分. 这些成果突出了RepoFactory环境的培训价值以及环境进化循环带来的额外收益.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being developed into agents that can carry out consequential work in real-world environments Team and others (2026) ; Xu et al. (2026) ; Team (2026) ; Yang et al. (2026a) ; DeepSeek-AI et al. () . Unlike static language tasks, agentic work unfolds through sustained interaction with environments. This transition changes the objective of model training: a capable agent must learn not only to produce correct answers, but also to make coherent progress toward completing long-horizon tasks Li et al. (2026a) ; Tian et al. (2026) ; Bajoria et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMS)正被日益发展成为能在现实世界环境团队等(2026)中开展相应工作的代理商;徐等(2026);团队(2026);杨等(2026a);DeepSeek-AI等(). 与静态语言任务不同,代理工作通过与环境的持续互动展开. 这一过渡改变了模式培训的目标:一个有能力的代理人不仅必须学会提出正确的答案,而且还必须在完成长期任务方面取得一致进展; 天等 (2026年); Bajoria等 (2026年).

blocks.en: Software engineering has become a major application of coding agents. Pipelines built around bug fixing and feature development have provided verifiable tasks for training agents on real codebases Pan et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025) . A successful local change, however, is only part of the work involved in delivering software. Coding agents are increasingly expected to handle more complex development processes and produce complete, working systems Yang et al. (2026c) ; Team et al. (2026) . Training on short-horizon tasks alone cannot cover this broader process, making it increasingly important to build repository-level environments for agent training.
blocks.zh: 软件工程已成为编码代理的主要应用. 围绕bug修复和特征开发而建的管道为Pan等人(2025年)的真实代码库培训人员提供了可核实的任务; Yang等人(2025年). 然而,成功的当地变革只是交付软件工作的一部分。 日益期望编码代理人处理更复杂的发展进程并产生完整的、可行的系统 杨等 (2026c). Team等 (2026) (英语). 仅就短期任务开展培训无法涵盖这一更广泛的进程,因此越来越需要为代理人培训建立储存层环境。

blocks.en: Constructing environments for long-horizon tasks at the repository level remains challenging. (i) Rigid construction pipelines limit the usable repository pool. DeNovoSWE Zhao et al. (2026) and MindForge Chen et al. (2026) follow linear construction pipelines. They refine documentation or resolve build failures while keeping the reference implementation fixed. Repositories that remain unsuitable are discarded, even when further revision could make them usable. Scaling therefore depends on finding more repositories that meet the same fixed requirements. (ii) Feedback focused on reliability overlooks training value. RefactorForge Ebrahimi et al. (2026) and TrajLong Peng et al. (2026a) design data for specific capabilities but do not explore how environment feedback can improve task content. ProgramGym Yang et al. (2026b) uses execution diagnostics and coverage feedback to repair builds and strengthen tests around a fixed reference implementation. These signals improve reliability without explicitly optimizing training value, which may remain limited when a task requires little implementation work or coordination across components. (iii) Feedback from model execution is costly and time-consuming. BenchEvolver Wu et al. (2026) and SETA Shen et al. (2026) use model performance to guide task revision. Obtaining this feedback requires model rollouts on the candidate tasks. For long-horizon coding tasks, each rollout can involve extensive implementation, increasing computational costs and delaying subsequent revisions. How to obtain timely, reliable feedback at low cost to improve training value and synthesize long-horizon coding environments at scale remains an open research question.
blocks.zh: 在储存库一级为长期任务建立环境仍然具有挑战性。 (一) 有固定的施工管线限制可用的储存池。 德新社 赵等 (2026)和MindForge Chen等 (2026)遵循线性建设管线. 它们完善文件或解决建设方面的故障,同时规定参照执行。 仍然不合适的仓库被丢弃,即使进一步修订可以使其有用。 因此,扩大规模取决于找到更多符合同样固定要求的储存库。 (二) 注重可靠性的反馈忽略了培训价值。 RefactorForge Ebrahimi等(2026)和TrajLong Peng等(2026a)特定能力的设计数据,但没有探索环境反馈如何能改进任务内容. 程序 游戏 Yang等 (2026b) 使用执行诊断和覆盖反馈来修复围绕固定参考实施构建和加强测试. 这些信号提高了可靠性,但没有明确优化培训价值,当一项任务不需要多少执行工作或各组成部分之间的协调时,培训价值可能仍然有限。 (三) 模式执行的反馈成本高而费时。 座椅 变化 吴等 (2026)和SETA沈等. (2026)使用模型性能指导任务修改. 要获得这种反馈,就需要示范推出候选任务。 对于远期编码任务,每次推出都可能涉及广泛的实施,会增加计算成本并推迟后续的修订. 如何以低成本及时获得可靠的反馈来提高培训价值并大规模地综合长相编码环境,仍然是一个开放的研究问题.

blocks.en: We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that transforms real-world repositories into verifiable environments. We design these environments around full repository generation task, in which an agent must build a complete, functioning repository from scratch given a language specification. We define a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope. It provides timely feedback at low cost without requiring a model to solve each candidate task. Our Environment Evolution Loop uses this objective to guide joint revisions to the oracle implementation, task specification, and tests. Validity feedback helps the loop repair initially unsuitable environments and recover repositories that would otherwise be discarded. Structural coupling and implementation scope serve as proxies for training value, directing revisions toward the implementation and integration work required by the task. A construction agent chooses how to modify each candidate and receives updated measurements after each revision, iterating within a fixed construction budget. Our main contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 我们提出RepoFactory,一个自动管道,将现实世界的储存库转化为可核查的环境. 我们围绕着完整的寄存器生成任务来设计这些环境,在这个任务中,一个代理必须从头开始建立一个完整的,功能完备的寄存器,只要有语言规格. 我们界定了一个结合有效性、结构结合和执行范围的多重目标。 它以低成本及时提供反馈,而不需要一个模式来解决每个候选人的任务。 我们的环境进化循环利用这一目标指导对甲骨文执行、任务规定和测试的联合修订。 有效性反馈有助于修复最初不合适的环境并恢复否则会被丢弃的寄存器. 结构结合和执行范围是培训价值的代名词,将修订工作导向任务所要求的执行和一体化工作。 施工代理人选择如何修改每个候选项目,并在每次修改后收到更新的测量结果,在固定的建筑预算范围内进行延展. 我们的主要贡献有三:

blocks.en: • We introduce RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real-world projects into 10,159 verifiable full-repository generation environments across 17 software domains. • We develop an Environment Evolution Loop that optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope. Timely, low-cost proxy feedback guides improvements to both environment reliability and training value. • Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on RepoFactory yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, with gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five coding and agentic benchmarks. Environment evolution contributes 5.1 and 2.1 points to these gains, respectively.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们引入RepoFactory,一个将现实世界的项目转换为10,159个可核查的全存储生成环境的自动化管线,覆盖了17个软件领域. 我们开发了环境进化循环,优化了结合有效性、结构结合和执行范围的多功能目标。 及时、低成本的代用反馈指导改善环境可靠性和培训价值。 • 培训Quen3.5-35B-A3B RepoFactory 产量 RepoHorizen-35B-A3B,在NL2Repo-Bench上平均得分22.6%,在5个编码和代理基准上平均得分8.5分。 环境演变分别为这些收益提供5.1和2.1分。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Scaling Verifiable Environments
blocks.zh: 2.1 可核实的环境

blocks.en: Environment synthesis scales agent training by generating interactive tasks with executable verification Kulikov et al. (2026) ; Ren et al. (2026) ; Zhu et al. (2025) . EnvScaler Song et al. (2026) and ScaleEnv Tu et al. (2026) target tool use, while Endless Terminals Gandhi et al. (2026) , LiteCoder-Terminal Peng et al. (2026b) , and CLI-Universe Hua et al. (2026) extend this approach to terminal-agent training. Broader task coverage, however, does not ensure that tasks preserve the interdependent requirements of real software or demand sustained development. RepoFactory derives full-repository generation tasks from real projects, grounding task behavior in existing implementations and tests. Reconstructing an entire repository requires sustained implementation and integration across these interdependent components.
blocks.zh: 通过生成可执行核查的Kulikov等人(2026年)、Ren等人(2026年)、Zhu等人(2025年)的互动任务,环境综合规模剂培训。 信封显示器 Song等人(2026年)和ScaleEnv Tu等人(2026年)使用目标工具,而Endless Terminers Gandhi等人(2026年),LiteCoder-Terminal 彭等 (2026年b),和CLI-Universe Hua等. (2026年)将这种方法扩展至终端代理培训. 然而,任务范围扩大并不能确保任务维护真实软件的相互依存要求或要求持续发展。 RepoFactory从真正的项目中获取了全存储生成任务,在现有执行和测试中奠定了任务行为的基础. 重建整个资料库需要持续地执行和整合这些相互依存的组成部分。

blocks.en: 2.2 Recursive Synthesis and Agent Self-Improvement
blocks.zh: 2.2 递归合成和物剂自我改进

blocks.en: Self-training reuses successful solutions as supervision, while self-play generates new problems for agents to solve Chen et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2026b) . BenchEvolver Wu et al. (2026) evolves reference solutions to construct harder tasks, while SETA Shen et al. (2026) adapts terminal environments using learner performance. DataMaster Du et al. (2026) optimizes training data using downstream evaluation scores, adding model training to the feedback cycle. These approaches rely on solver rollouts or downstream training, increasing computational costs and delaying feedback. To our knowledge, RepoFactory is the first to evolve full-repository generation environments using an objective that combines validity checks with inexpensive code metrics. This objective provides timely feedback without requiring solver rollouts or downstream training.
blocks.zh: 自训练再利用成功的解决方案作为监督,而自玩则给代理商带来新的问题来解决 陈等 (2024); 李等 (2026b). 座椅 变化 Wu等 (2026) 演化出参考解决方案来构建更难的任务,而SETA Shen等. (2026)利用学习者的表现来适应终端环境. 数据主机 Du等 (2026)利用下游评价分数优化了培训数据,为反馈周期增加了模型培训. 这些方法依靠解答者推出或下游培训,增加计算成本并推迟反馈. 据我们所知,RepoFactory是第一个利用将有效性检查与廉价代码度量衡相结合的目标来发展全存储生成环境的. 这一目标提供及时的反馈,而不需要解决者推出或下游培训。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of RepoFactory. The pipeline searches for repositories, reconstructs their runtimes, and synthesizes task specifications from repository evidence. The Environment Evolution Loop uses low-cost feedback to improve environment reliability and training value.
blocks.zh: 图1:RepoFactory概况. 管道搜索仓库,重建其运行时间,并从仓库证据中综合任务规格. 环境进化圈利用低成本反馈来提高环境可靠性和培训价值.

blocks.en: 3 RepoFactory
blocks.zh: 3 回放事实

blocks.en: RepoFactory converts real-world repositories into verifiable environments where agents reconstruct complete projects from a language specifications. The Environment Evolution Loop uses timely, low-cost feedback from verification and code analysis to jointly revise oracle implementations, task specifications, and tests, optimizing a multiplicative objective over validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope. All construction agents use Qwen3.8-Max. Figure 1 shows the overall pipeline.
blocks.zh: RepoFactory将现实世界的寄存器转换为可核查的环境,使代理商根据语言规格重建完成项目. 环境进化循环利用核查和代码分析的及时、低成本反馈,联合修订甲骨文执行、任务规格和测试,优化多重目标,使其超过有效性、结构结合和执行范围。 所有建筑代理都使用Quen3.8-Max. 图1显示整个管道。

blocks.en: 3.2 Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 建筑管道

blocks.en: RepoFactory searches public code-hosting platforms for candidate repositories, excluding those included in established coding benchmarks to avoid evaluation overlap. Eligible projects must provide package metadata and a nonempty local test suite to support isolated installation and evaluation. To balance task complexity with reconstruction cost, we require at least five implementation files and fewer than 40,000 lines of Python code. We exclude projects that require external services, outbound network access, graphical interfaces, or specialized hardware. Network-related projects remain eligible when their tests mock external calls or use only local connections.
blocks.zh: RepoFactory为候选寄存器搜索公共代码托管平台,但不包括列入既定编码基准以避免评价重叠的平台. 符合条件的项目必须提供包元数据以及非空的本地测试套件,以支持孤立的安装和评价. 为了平衡任务的复杂性与重建成本,我们至少需要5个执行文件,不到4万行的Python代码. 我们排除了需要外部服务、外部网络访问、图形界面或专门硬件的项目。 网络相关项目在测试模拟外部调用或仅使用本地连接时仍符合条件.

blocks.en: For each candidate repository, RepoFactory copies each candidate repository into an isolated task directory and builds a Docker image from its build files and dependency manifests. A agent installs dependencies, identifies test commands, and revises the image or execution configuration as needed. We retain a repository only when all tests pass in a fresh container with bounded resources and no network access. RepoFactory archives the validated image and records the installation and test commands, package files, and test results.
blocks.zh: 对于每个候选寄存器,RepoFactory将每个候选寄存器复制到一个孤立的任务目录并从其构建的文件和依赖性列表中构建出多克图像. 代理安装依赖性,识别测试命令,并根据需要修改图像或执行配置. 我们只保留一个储存库,只有在所有测试都通过一个有固定资源且没有网络接入的新容器时。 RepoFactory将已验证的图像归档,并记录安装和测试命令,包文件,以及测试结果.

blocks.en: After establishing the runtime, RepoFactory analyzes the repository in a read only container to determine what the task specification must cover. A scanner based on abstract syntax trees extracts public classes, functions, and methods, together with their signatures, exceptions, and return information. It also records repository symbols imported by tests and builds an implementation tree excluding test files. These outputs guide task synthesis and, together with dependency metadata, provide the inputs for computing structural coupling and implementation scope.
blocks.zh: 在建立运行时间后,RepoFactory在只读的容器中分析寄存器,以确定任务规格必须涵盖哪些内容. 基于抽象语法树的扫描器会提取公共类,功能,方法,以及它们的签名,例外,和回回信息. 它还记录通过测试导入的寄存器符号,并建立一个排除测试文件的执行树. 这些产出指导任务综合,并与依赖元数据一起为计算结构耦合和执行范围提供投入。

blocks.en: RepoFactory prepares an isolated workspace with dependencies installed and disabled external network access. The coding agent must reconstruct the project from the task specification, without access to the original repository or evaluation code. The synthesis agent uses the repository analysis to write this specification and an accompanying API manifest. The specification describes the repository’s functionality and structure, while the API manifest documents the public interfaces the agent must implement.
blocks.zh: RepoFactory 准备一个孤立的工作空间,安装了依赖性并禁用外部网络访问. 编码代理必须从任务规格重建项目,不得访问原始寄存器或评价代码. 合成剂使用寄存器分析来写出这个规格并附带一个API的表单. 规格描述寄存器的功能和结构,而API 显示则记录代理必须执行的公共接口.

blocks.en: Functionally correct implementations can still fail if their interface names or import paths differ from those expected by the tests. RepoFactory therefore checks the specification and API manifest against the repository symbols imported by the original tests, returning missing symbols and their import records to the synthesis agent for revision. Once this check passes, RepoFactory combines the specification with the validated runtime image to create the environment. The original repository remains isolated as the oracle, and evaluation resources are available only during verification.
blocks.zh: 如果其界面名称或导入路径与测试预期的路径不同,功能正确的执行仍然可能失败. RepoFactory因此对照原始测试所导入的寄存器符号检查规格和API表,将缺失的符号及其导入记录退回合成剂进行修改. 一旦这次检查通过,RepoFactory将规格与经过验证的运行时间图像相结合来创造环境. 原始寄存器作为甲骨文仍被隔离,评价资源仅在核查期间提供.

blocks.en: After materialization, RepoFactory first checks validity A A . The oracle O O must receive full reward, and the unchanged initial workspace must receive zero reward. If either condition fails, the construction agent uses the validation report and execution trace to identify the cause and repair the candidate. The revised environment is evaluated again, and optimization of scope and coupling begins only after both checks pass.
blocks.zh: 实现后,RepoFactory首先检查有效性A A. 甲骨文O必须获得全额奖励,未改变的初始工作空间必须获得零奖励. 如果任一条件都失败,施工代理机构利用鉴定报告和执行追踪来查明原因并修复候选人。 对经过修改的环境再次进行评估,只有在两次检查合格后才能开始优化范围和组合。

blocks.en: A valid environment may still require little implementation work. Implementation scope S S therefore guides revisions toward more substantial reconstruction tasks. A larger project can still consist of independent components, so structural coupling C C complements scope by directing evolution toward more interdependent functionality. The construction agent decides how to revise the oracle implementation, task specification, and tests, keeping the description and evaluation consistent with the revised functionality.
blocks.zh: 一个有效的环境可能仍然需要很少的执行工作。 因此,SS指导修订工作,以完成更实质性的重建任务。 一个更大的项目仍然可以由独立的组件组成,因此结构耦合C通过引导进化到更相互依赖的功能来补充范围. 施工代理机构决定如何修改甲骨文实施,任务规格和测试,使描述和评价与修改后的功能保持一致.

blocks.en: For each valid candidate, the agent compares S S and C C against thresholds of 0.5 0.5 and 0.01 0.01 , respectively, and prioritizes any term below threshold. When both thresholds are met, the agent chooses which term to optimize under Q Q . Each revision is rechecked for validity before the scores are reassessed, with validity failures returned to repair. A revision targeting S S or C C is retained only if the selected score strictly increases; otherwise, RepoFactory restores the previous version. The loop runs for up to 12 rounds, assessing each revision through verifier execution and code analysis without solving-agent rollouts or downstream training and evaluation. RepoFactory uses this low-cost feedback to recover failed candidates and improve valid tasks, increasing both the yield and training value of repository-level environments.
blocks.zh: 对于每个有效候选人,代理人将SS和C分别比作0.5和0.01的阈值,并优先处理低于阈值的任何任期。 当两个阈值都达到时,代理选择在QQ下优化哪个术语. 每次修订都要在重新评估分数之前重新检查是否有效,并恢复有效性故障修复. 只有所选分数严格增加时,才保留针对S S或C C的修订;否则,RepoFactory恢复了上个版本. 该循环运行了多达12个回合,通过核查器执行和代码分析来评估每次修订,而没有解决代理推出或下游培训和评价. RepoFactory利用这种低成本的反馈来找回失败的候选人并改进有效的任务,既能增加存储层环境的产量又能提高培训价值.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Statistics of RepoFactory environments and SFT data.
blocks.zh: 图2:RepoFactory环境统计和SFT数据.

blocks.en: 4 Analysis of Synthesized Data
blocks.zh: 4 合成数据分析

blocks.en: Effective training environments for long-horizon coding should expose agents to diverse software and require substantial repository reconstruction under reliable feedback across a broad range of difficulty. Our 10,159 RepoFactory environments span 17 domains and place agents in complete repository reconstruction tasks with executable validation. To collect SFT data, we run Qwen3.8-Max five times on each environment, filter out low reward trajectories, and retain 10,947 samples spanning 5,577 environments. We analyze the resulting collection to characterize its diversity, scale, interaction length, and difficulty with the statistics summarized in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 长期编码的有效培训环境应使代理商接触到各种软件,并需要在各种困难的可靠反馈下对储存库进行大量重建。 我们的10,159个再现环境跨越了17个域,并将代理人置于完整的仓库重建任务中,并进行可执行的验证。 为了收集SFT数据,我们在每个环境上运行了5次Quen3.8-Max,过滤出低回报轨迹,并保留了10,947个样本,覆盖了5,577个环境. 我们分析所收集的数据,以描述其多样性、规模、互动时间和与图2所汇总的统计数据的难度。

blocks.en: The collection covers a broad range of application domains and technical ecosystems, without being dominated by any single area, as shown in Figure 2 (a). The largest category accounts for only 12.5% of environments, and only 6.9% fall outside the named domains, indicating broad coverage rather than concentration. Its varied libraries, interfaces, and implementation conventions expose agents to the diversity of real software development. This breadth supports training agents that generalize across software projects instead of specializing in a narrow domain.
blocks.zh: 如图2(a)所示,该汇编涵盖广泛的应用领域和技术生态系统,不以任何单一领域为主。 最大的类别仅占环境的12.5%,只有6.9%不属于指定领域,表明覆盖面较广,而不是集中。 其各种图书馆、界面和执行公约使代理商暴露于真实软件开发的多样性。 这种宽度支持将软件项目普遍化而不是专门化于狭义领域的培训代理人.

blocks.en: These environments require agents to reconstruct substantial codebases rather than write isolated programs. As shown in Figure 2 (b), the median oracle contains 4.2k lines of source code, with a substantial tail of larger systems. Across the 10,159 instances with successful test parsing, the verifier contains 2.09 million statically identified test definitions, providing dense coverage at the instance level. Because these tests are inherited from the source repositories, they exercise behavior across the public interface rather than checking only a few end to end outcomes. Success therefore depends on implementing a coherent repository whose components remain consistent under extensive verification.
blocks.zh: 这些环境要求代理人重建实质性的代码库,而不是写出孤立的程序. 如图2(b)所示,中位甲骨文包含4.2k行的源代码,大系统有相当的尾部. 在10 159个测试解析成功的情况下,核查员包含209万个静态识别的测试定义,在实例一级提供了密集的涵盖范围。 由于这些测试是从源寄存器中继承的,因此它们在整个公共界面中进行行为,而不是只检查几个端来达到最终结果. 因此,成功与否取决于建立一个协调一致的储存库,其组成部分在广泛核查下保持不变。

blocks.en: The environments and trajectories capture sustained development at the repository level. The median oracle repository contains 26 source files, and the median SFT trajectory contains 64 assistant turns, as shown in Figure 2 (c). A successful trajectory must keep track of a multi-file project while successive edits are implemented and tested. Together, the long-horizon trajectories and varied operations provide rich supervision for maintaining project state as agents coordinate changes across files and refine their implementations through execution feedback.
blocks.zh: 环境和轨迹捕捉到储存层的持续发展。 中位元甲骨文寄存器包含26个源文件,中位子SFT轨迹包含64个助手转折,如图2(c)所示. 成功的轨迹必须跟踪一个多文件项目,同时进行并测试连续的编辑. 长视轨迹和各种业务共同为维持项目状态提供了丰富的监督,因为代理人协调不同档案的变动,并通过执行反馈来完善其执行情况。

blocks.en: Figure 2 (d) shows the distribution of implementation scope S S and its relationship with reconstruction performance. We measure each environment’s success rate as the fraction of teacher trajectories receiving full reward. Environments with matched trajectories are ordered by S S and divided into five equally sized groups, whose mean scope and success rates are plotted in the lower panel. Mean success falls from 23.0% in the group with the smallest scope to 13.4% in the group with the largest. This trend supports S S as a proxy for the demands of repository reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 图2(d)显示执行范围SS的分布情况及其与重建业绩的关系。 我们测量每个环境的成功率是教师获得全额奖励的轨迹的一小部分。 具有相匹配轨迹的环境由S S 订购,并被分为5个等大小的组,其平均范围和成功率由下层面板绘制. 平均成功率从规模最小的群体的23.0%下降到规模最大的群体的13.4%。 这一趋势支持S S作为寄存器重建需求的代用.

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results on five agent benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表1:五个代理基准的主要结果。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate our model on five benchmarks covering repository generation, software engineering, and terminal-based tasks. NL2Repo Ding et al. (2025) is a long-horizon coding benchmark that requires agents to implement a complete repository from scratch based on a natural language description. Success requires sustained planning, tool use, and coordinated implementation across multiple files and modules. SWE-bench Verified Jimenez et al. (2024) , SWE-bench Pro Deng et al. (2025) , and SWE-bench Multilingual Zan et al. (2025) assess the ability to resolve issues in existing repositories, while Terminal-Bench 2.1 Merrill et al. (2026) evaluates task completion in terminal environments. Together, these benchmarks measure coding-agent performance across both project construction and repository maintenance.
blocks.zh: 我们以五个基准来评价我们的模型,这些基准包括储存库的生成、软件工程和终端任务。 NL2雷波语Name 丁等 (2025年)是一个长相线编码基准,需要代理根据自然语言描述从头实施完整的寄存器. 成功需要持续的规划、工具使用和多个文件和模块的协调执行。 SWE-bench 核查Jimenez等人(2024年),SWE-bench Pro Deng等人(2025年),和SWE-bench多语言Zan等人(2025年)评估解决现有寄存器中问题的能力,而Terminal-Bench 2.1 Merrill等人(2026年)则评价终端环境中的任务完成情况. 这些基准共同衡量项目建设和储存库维护方面的编码代理业绩。

blocks.en: We use Claude Code version 2.1.140 as the agent scaffold. The maximum context length is 262,144 tokens, and the maximum output length is 32,768 tokens. Context is automatically compacted when its usage reaches 80% of the maximum context length. For decoding, we set temperature to 1.0, top- p p to 0.95, and top- k k to 20.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Claude代码2.1.140版本作为代理脚手架. 最大上下文长度为262,144个令牌,最大输出长度为32,768个令牌. 当其用法达到最大上下文长度的80%时,上下文会自动收紧. 为了解码,我们把温度设定为1.0,p上设定为0.95,k上设定为20.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 compares RepoHorizen-35B-A3B and its base model with representative closed-source and open-weight models. On NL2Repo, which directly evaluates full-repository reconstruction, training raises the score from 23.8 to 46.4, a gain of 22.6 points. This is the strongest listed result among open-weight models below 200B parameters. RepoHorizen also surpasses GPT-5.5 and Gemini-3.1 Pro, which score 45.1 and 33.4, respectively, as well as larger open-weight models DeepSeek-V4-Pro and MiniMax-M3, which score 38.5 and 42.1. Improvements extend to all four remaining benchmarks, with gains of 1.3 to 6.8 points across issue resolution and cross-domain long-horizon tasks in Terminal-Bench 2.1. These results suggest that RepoFactory training transfers beyond repository generation to broader software engineering and terminal work at fixed model scale. Environment evolution further strengthens this performance across all five benchmarks, adding 5.1 points on NL2Repo and 2.1 points on average over the no-evolution variant. These additional gains support the effectiveness of our proxy metrics in guiding environment evolution that improve training value.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了RepoHorizen-35B-A3B及其基础模型与代表性的闭源和开量模型. 在直接评价全库重建的NL2Repo上,训练将分数从23.8分提高到46.4分,收获了22.6分. 这是200B参数以下的开放式模型中列出的最强结果. RepoHorizen也超越了GPT-5.5和双子座-3.1 Pro,分别得分为45.1分和33.4分;还超越了更大的开量型号DeepSeek-V4-Pro和MiniMax-M3,分别得分为38.5分和42.1分. 改进范围扩大到所有其余4个基准,在解决问题和Bench 2.1号终端的跨领域长视距任务之间增加1.3至6.8分。 这些结果表明,RepoFactory培训从存储器生成到更广泛的软件工程以及固定模型规模的终端工作. 环境演化在所有五个基准中都进一步加强了这一表现,在NL2Repo上增加了5.1分,在"不演化"变体上平均增加了2.1分. 这些额外收益支持我们的代理衡量标准在指导环境演变以提高培训价值方面的效力。

blocks.en: 5.3 Environment Scaling
blocks.zh: 5.3 环境放大

blocks.en: Figure 3: Average accuracy as a function of the number of RepoFactory training environments.
blocks.zh: 图3:平均精度作为RepoFactory训练环境数量的一个函数.

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows how NL2Repo performance changes as the training set grows. Performance increases steadily from 23.8% without RepoFactory environments to 46.4% with 5,577 environments, consistent with the 22.6-point gain reported in Table 1 . The improvement continues at the largest scale tested, with no evidence of saturation.
blocks.zh: 图3显示NL2Repo的性能随着训练集的增长而变化. 业绩稳步从23.8%(无再生环境)上升到46.4%(有5 577个环境),与表1中报告的22.6点增益一致。 改进工作继续在经过测试的最大范围内进行,没有饱和的迹象。

blocks.en: The gains become more pronounced beyond 3,000 environments. Adding the remaining 2,577 environments raises performance from 36.5% to 46.4%, suggesting that the larger collection exposes the model to repository structures and behavioral requirements that smaller subsets do not cover. Scaling the environment set therefore expands the supervision available for long-horizon repository reconstruction and continues to improve performance well beyond the earliest additions.
blocks.zh: 这些成果在3 000个环境之外变得更加明显。 加上剩下的2,577个环境,性能从36.5%提高到了46.4%,说明更大的收藏使模型暴露在寄存器结构和行为要求上,而较小的子集并不覆盖. 因此,扩大环境范围将扩大长视距储存库重建的监督范围,并继续大大地改进业绩,远远超出最初增加的范围。

blocks.en: 5.4 Scaling Across Model Sizes
blocks.zh: 5.4 跨模型大小的放大

blocks.en: Figure 4: NL2Repo performance across model sizes.
blocks.zh: 图4:NL2 跨模型大小的回波性能.

blocks.en: We examine how the benefits of RepoFactory training vary with model capacity. Figure 4 reports NL2Repo gains of 12.2 to 22.6 percentage points across the 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B models, showing that full-repository task remains useful across different parameter budgets. The 35B-A3B model gains the most despite the 27B model’s higher baseline, suggesting that stronger initial performance does not necessarily translate into greater benefit from this training.
blocks.zh: 我们审视了再现培训的好处如何因模型能力而异。 图4显示,在9B、27B和35B-A3B模型中,NL2Repo的12.2至22.6个百分点的增益表明,在不同的参数预算中,全部存储任务仍然有用。 35B-A3B模式获得的收益最大,尽管27B模式的基准较高,这表明较强的初始性能不一定会转化为从这种培训中获得更大的利益。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Statistics of the four difficulty levels and the corresponding NL2Repo results.
blocks.zh: 图5:四个难度等级的统计和相应的NL2Repo结果.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Cumulative number of validated environments over wall-clock time, sampled every 30 minutes.
blocks.zh: 图6:每30分钟抽取一次的墙上时间累积的经验证的环境数量。

blocks.en: 5.5 Effect of the Data Source
blocks.zh: 5.5 数据来源的影响

blocks.en:
Table 2: Performance of models trained on different SWE data sources, in percent.
N2R = NL2Repo, Ver. = SWE-bench Verified, Pro = SWE-bench Pro,
ML = SWE-bench Multilingual, TB = Terminal-Bench 2.1.
Best result among our runs in bold .
blocks.zh:
表2:在瑞典妇女权力署不同数据来源方面接受培训的模型绩效,百分比。
N2R = NL2Repo, Ver. = SWE-bench 验证, Pro = SWE-bench Pro, 出品人 出品人.

blocks.en: We compare RepoFactory with existing SWE datasets to assess the training value of its environments. We collect trajectories on six open datasets and apply the same cleaning procedure as for RepoFactory. Each baseline contains 11,000 training trajectories, slightly more than RepoFactory. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-35B-A3B separately on each collection and evaluate the models with the Claude Code harness. Table 2 includes both published results and these controlled comparisons. Among the published results, obtained with varying harnesses, the highest NL2Repo score is 28.9. RepoFactory reaches 46.4 and leads all six open-data baselines on all five benchmarks. On NL2Repo, its advantage over the strongest baseline, OpenSWE, is 21.2 points. The teacher is the same across our runs, so its strength alone cannot explain this advantage. The results support the value of the training experience provided by RepoFactory’s environments.
blocks.zh: 我们比较RepoFactory与现有的SWE数据集,以评估其环境的培训价值. 我们收集六个开放数据集的轨迹,并采用与RepoFactory相同的清洗程序. 每个基线包含11000个训练轨迹,略高于RepoFactory. 我们分别对每集的Quen3.5-35B-A3B进行微调,并用克洛德代码的绳套来评价模型. 表2包括公布的结果和这些有控制的比较。 在公布的结果中,通过各种取材获得的NL2Repo最高得分为28.9. RepoFactory达到了46.4,在所有五个基准上领导所有六个开放数据基线. 在NL2Repo上,它相对于最强基线OpenSWE的优势为21.2分. 老师对我们来说是一样的, 所以光靠他的力量无法解释这个优势。 结果证实了RepoFactory环境提供的培训经验的价值。

blocks.en: 5.6 Ablation of the Evolution Objective
blocks.zh: 5.6 进化目标

blocks.en: The evolution objective must support both the recovery of usable environments and improvements in training value. We evaluate these effects separately, using oracle validation to measure candidate recovery and downstream training to assess S S and C C as optimization targets. For recovery, we uniformly sample 500 repositories from the filtered candidate set and compare runs allowing up to three repair steps and none. We compare the number of environments satisfying A = 1 A=1 , with concurrency, timeouts, and infrastructure retry budgets held fixed.
blocks.zh: 演变目标必须支持恢复可利用的环境和提高培训价值。 我们分别评估这些影响,利用甲骨文验证来衡量候选人的恢复和下游培训,将S和C评估为优化目标。 为了回收,我们统一抽取了500个储存库,从经过过滤的候选设备中抽取,并进行比较,最多可以进行三个修理步骤,没有。 我们比较了满足A=1A=1的环境数量,而固定的货币、超时和基础设施预算。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows that evolution increases the number of validated environments from 169 to 347, raising yield from 33.8% to 69.4% under the same acceptance criterion. These gains suggest that many initial failures stem from construction defects that can be corrected through execution feedback. Most of the improvement comes from the first repair, with smaller gains from subsequent steps. Recovering these otherwise discarded candidates expands the supply of valid environments from the same repository pool, supporting environment generation at scale.
blocks.zh: 图6显示,演化使经验证的环境数量从169个增加到347个,根据同样的接受标准,产量从33.8%增加到69.4%。 这些收益表明,许多最初的失败来自建筑缺陷,可以通过执行反馈加以纠正. 大部分改进出自于先期修复,从后期步骤得到的收益较小. 收回这些原本被丢弃的考生,可以扩大同一库库中有效环境的供应,支持规模化的环境生成.

blocks.en: To assess whether optimizing S S and C C improves training value, we run two independent evolution experiments from the same 1,000 randomly sampled environments. Each experiment targets one metric while retaining validity checks. We collect environments after rounds 3, 6, 9, and 12 as Levels 1 through 4, respectively. Each level supplies 2,000 trajectories for fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with the same initialization and optimization settings.
blocks.zh: 为了评估优化S S 和 C C 是否提高训练价值,我们从同一个1000个随机抽样的环境进行两个独立的演化实验. 每个实验都针对一个度量衡,同时保留有效性检查. 我们收集3、6、9和12轮后的环境,分别作为1至4级。 每个关卡都提供2000个轨迹来进行精细调整 Quen3.5-35B-A3B 相同的初始化和优化设置.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 5 , optimizing S S produces longer interactions and contexts and more supervised tokens. NL2Repo accuracy increases steadily from 30.2% at Level 1 to 32.9% at Level 4. Expanding implementation scope thus provides more extensive development experience within a fixed number of trajectories, accompanied by improved reconstruction performance.
blocks.zh: 如图5所显示,优化SS会产生较长的相互作用和背景,以及更多的受监督的标志. NL2 数据 Repo精度稳步从1级的30.2%提高到32.9%  4.四. 因此,扩大执行范围在一定的轨道范围内提供了更广泛的发展经验,同时重建业绩也有所改善。

blocks.en: Optimizing C C produces a different pattern. Accuracy fluctuates at intermediate levels but reaches 32.5% at Level 4, compared with 30.2% at Level 1. Interaction length decreases, while context length and supervised token counts decline only slightly. The improvement therefore does not depend on longer trajectories or additional supervision. This complements the scope ablation, suggesting that training value depends not only on the extent of implementation work but also on the relationships among the components being implemented.
blocks.zh: 优化 C 产生不同的模式. 中间水平的准确性波动,但4级达到32.5%,而30.2% 1. 联合国 交互长度会减少,而上下文长度和受监督的令牌计数只会略有下降. 因此,改进并不取决于更长的轨道或额外的监督。 这补充了范围缩小,表明培训的价值不仅取决于执行工作的程度,而且取决于所执行的组成部分之间的关系。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that constructs verifiable environments for full-repository generation from real-world projects. Its Environment Evolution Loop uses timely, low-cost feedback to optimize validity, implementation scope, and structural coupling, recovering failed conversions and improving task value. The resulting 10,159 environments span 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, with gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five coding and agentic benchmarks. Environment evolution contributes a further 5.1 and 2.1 points over training without evolution. These findings highlight the value of repository-level environments for coding-agent training and support low-cost proxy objectives as a practical means of improving their training value at scale.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了RepoFactory,一个自动管道,它为从现实世界项目中生成全部存储器构建可核查的环境。 其"环境进化循环"(Environment Evolution Loop)利用及时,低成本的反馈来优化有效性,执行范围,以及结构耦合,恢复失败的转换并提升任务价值. 由此产生的10 159个环境跨越了17个软件域。 关于这些环境的Quen3.5-35B-A3B培训产生RepoHorizen-35B-A3B,NL2Repo-Bench的增益为22.6%,5个编码和代理基准的平均增益为8.5分。 环境演变比没有演变的培训进一步贡献了5.1和2.1分。 这些结论突出了储存库一级环境对编码代理培训的价值,并支持低成本代用目标,以此作为大规模提高其培训价值的切实手段。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: RepoFactory currently focuses on Python projects, with relatively limited coverage of other programming languages. Our proxy metrics provide useful, low-cost guidance for environment evolution, but characterize task content at a broad structural level. They do not yet explicitly distinguish the capabilities required by individual tasks. Extending language coverage and incorporating more detailed information about these capability requirements could support a wider range of development settings and more targeted training.
blocks.zh: RepoFactory目前专注于Python项目,其他编程语言的覆盖范围相对有限. 我们的代用衡量标准为环境演变提供了有用和低成本的指导,但从广泛的结构层面描述任务内容。 它们尚未明确区分各项任务所需的能力。 扩大语文覆盖面并纳入关于这些能力要求的更详细资料,可以支持更广泛的发展环境和更有针对性的培训。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en: This appendix describes the trajectory preparation and supervised fine-tuning configuration used for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.
blocks.zh: 本附录介绍用于Quen3.5-35B-A3B的轨迹准备和受监督的微调配置.

blocks.en: A.1 Trajectory Filtering and Cleaning
blocks.zh: A.1 轨迹过滤和清理

blocks.en: Before fine-tuning, we retain trajectories with rewards above 0.5 0.5 and apply offline quality checks. Deterministic checks examine record validity, dialogue structure, consistency between tool calls and results, response completeness, and the formatting of reasoning and code. They also screen for repetition, interaction loops, contamination, potentially sensitive or harmful content, and attempts to obtain information outside the intended task environment. We discard trajectories with clear violations and flag ambiguous cases for review.
blocks.zh: 在微调前,保留奖励超过0.5分的轨迹并实行线下质量检查. 决定性检查检查检查记录的有效性,对话结构,工具调用和结果的一致性,响应的完整性,以及推理和代码的格式. 它们还筛选重复、互动循环、污染、潜在敏感或有害内容,并试图在预定任务环境之外获取信息。 我们放弃明显违反的轨迹,并标出模糊不清的案件供审查。

blocks.en: A language-model judge reviews the flagged trajectories. These trajectories are included in the SFT data only when the judge determines that the apparent violation is benign. Confirmed violations and unresolved cases remain excluded.
blocks.zh: 一名语言模型法官审查标有标记的轨迹。 这些轨迹只有在法官认定明显侵权为良性时才被列入SFT数据. 已确认的违反行为和未解决的案件仍然排除在外。

blocks.en: A.2 SFT Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: A.2 资助恐怖主义 超参数

blocks.en: Table 3: Supervised fine-tuning hyperparameters for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.
blocks.zh: 表3: Quen3.5-35B-A3B的监理微调超参数.

blocks.en: We fine-tune the model, using the settings in Table 3 . The data are shuffled during training, with no online generation. Following the Qwen3.5 multi-turn objective, we compute the loss over assistant spans, including tool calls. System, user, and tool-result turns provide context but receive no loss.
blocks.zh: 我们利用表3中的设置来调整模型。 数据在训练期间被洗刷,没有在线生成. 按照Qwen3.5的多回合目标,我们计算出包括工具呼叫在内的助手跨度的损失. 系统、用户和工具结果转换提供了上下文,但不会丢失。

blocks.en: The rollout and global batch sizes are both 64, and the per-device micro-batch size is 1. Dynamic token batching limits each GPU to 80,000 tokens, with no separate sequence-length cap. Tensor, context, and expert parallel sizes are 2, 4, and 8, respectively. Sequence parallelism is enabled, while pipeline and expert tensor parallel sizes are both 1.
blocks.zh: 推出和全球批量尺寸均为64个,每台设备微批量尺寸为1. 动态令牌批量将每个GPU限制在8万个令牌,没有单独的序列长封顶. tensor,上下文和专家平行尺寸分别为2,4和8. 序列平行主义被启用,而管道和专家的拉诺平行尺寸都是1.

blocks.en: We use AdamW with weight decay of 0.1 0.1 and coefficients β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 and β 2 = 0.98 \beta_{2}=0.98 . The learning rate warms up to 1.0 × 10 − 6 1.0\times 10^{-6} over the first 10% of training, then decays to 1.0 × 10 − 7 1.0\times 10^{-7} following a cosine schedule.
blocks.zh: 我们使用重衰减为0.1的亚当W,系数为β 1 = 0.9\β1\0.9和β 2 = 0.98\β2\0.98。 学习率在训练前10%时会升温到1.0××10-6 1.0\times 10×6},然后按照余弦排行表衰减到1.0×10-7 1.0\times 10×7}.

blocks.en: Appendix B Additional Dataset Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录B 补充数据集分析

blocks.en: B.1 Python Ecosystem Coverage
blocks.zh: B.1  Py生态系统 覆盖范围

blocks.en: Figure 7: Estimated Python ecosystem coverage across RepoFactory’s 10,159 environments. Categories may overlap. Other denotes environments without an ecosystem match.
blocks.zh: 图7:RepoFactory 10,159个环境的Python生态系统覆盖率估计。 类别可能重叠。 其他表示没有生态系统匹配的环境。

blocks.en: Figure 7 summarizes the estimated coverage of Python ecosystems across RepoFactory’s 10,159 environments. The estimates use the available Python repository records. We assign ecosystem labels by matching direct runtime dependency names against predefined rules. For repositories without a dependency-based match, we use ecosystem terms in the first substantive paragraph of the project description. An environment may belong to multiple categories.
blocks.zh: 图7总结了Python生态系统在RepoFactory10,159个环境中的估计覆盖范围。 估计使用现有的Python寄存器记录. 我们通过将直接运行时间的依赖性名称与预定规则相匹配来指定生态系统标签. 对于没有依赖性匹配的寄存器,我们在项目说明的第一实质性段落中使用生态系统术语. 环境可能属于多个类别。

blocks.en: Validation and serialization are the most common category at 32.7%, followed by HTTP, networking, and asynchronous tooling at 28.6%. Numerical computing, command-line tools, text processing, and data analysis are also widely represented. The distribution extends from common application infrastructure to specialized scientific libraries, web frameworks, and machine-learning frameworks, covering a range of software stacks for repository reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 验证和序列化是最常见的类别,为32.7%,其次是HTTP,联网,以及28.6%的同步工具. 数字计算,命令行工具,文本处理,以及数据分析也得到了广泛的体现. 发行范围从共同的应用基础设施扩展到专门的科学图书馆、网络框架和机器学习框架,涵盖一系列用于仓库重建的软件堆.

blocks.en: B.2 Development Operations in Training Trajectories
blocks.zh: B.2 培训轨迹方面的发展业务

blocks.en: Figure 8: Development operations in the collected trajectories. Each bar shows the percentage of trajectories containing the operation. Categories may overlap.
blocks.zh: 图 8:所收轨迹的开发业务. 每个栏显示包含操作的轨迹百分比. 类别可能重叠。

blocks.en: We examine the development activities represented in the collected trajectories by classifying operations from tool names and shell-command contents. Figure 8 reports the percentage of trajectories containing each operation. A trajectory may contribute to several categories.
blocks.zh: 我们通过从工具名称和 shell-command 内容对操作进行分类,来审查所收集的轨道中所体现的发展活动。 图8报告了包含每项操作的轨迹百分比。 轨迹可能有助于若干类别。

blocks.en: Reading and writing files occur in almost all trajectories, alongside frequent workspace exploration and code modification. Inline Python execution appears in 88.2% of trajectories, assertion or diff checks in 78.0%, and test-suite execution in 33.2%. These activities provide supervision for both implementing project code and examining its behavior through execution and local checks.
blocks.zh: 阅读和写作文件几乎出现在所有轨迹中,同时经常进行工作空间探索和代码修改. 内置的 Python 执行出现在88.2%的轨迹,78.0%的断言或diff 检查,33.2%的测试-套期执行. 这些活动对执行项目守则和通过执行和地方检查检查其行为提供了监督。
